comparison.objective: Size-separate ceramic media from washers, versus scrape griddle debris into a grease tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Orientation-dependent passage and bridge clearing through a screen versus planar scraping with blade-angle control.
comparison.success_condition: At least 98% media recovery with all washers retained and no loss, versus debris-mass transfer with cleanliness, spill and gouge limits.
comparison.reason: Both recover loose material, but one tests selective aperture flow and retention while the other tests surface scraping.
